text.p: The following are some leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers not already reported by Reuters.
- Dozens of boats and hundreds of fishermen will gather today at the port of Lisbon to protest against a government decree banning fishing during 24 hours at the weekends.
- Sopete to take 50 percent of the Estoril Sol tourism group, becoming its biggest stockholder.
- The government approves a bill giving more financial support to single mothers.
- Cable company Yazako-Saltano will lay off 1,900 of its 4,400 workers of its plant in Serzedo, in northern Portugal, said trade union official Jose Alberto Arouco.
- The government will decide the location of Lisbon's planned second airport by the end of the year.
- Environment Minister Elisa Ferreira to announce today the launching of the Water and Residues Institute, aimed at preparing the sector for private investment.
